title: Make a countdown
description: Use a while loop to count down from a number you choose, then print a final message.
solution:
number = 3
while number > 0:
    print(number)
    number -= 1
print("Go!")

title: Add numbers with while
description: Use a while loop to add a sequence of numbers and print the total. Choose the range.
solution:
total = 0
number = 1
while number <= 4:
    total += number
    number += 1
print(total)

title: Count digits with while
description: Choose a positive whole number and use a while loop to count its digits. Print the count.
solution:
number = 5821
count = 0
while number > 0:
    count += 1
    number //= 10
print(count)
